name: ReliefWeb Jobs
notes: UN OCHA humanitarian job board. Uses the v2 API (the old v1 endpoint returned HTTP 410 Gone in testing on 2026-11-06). ReliefWeb now requires a pre-approved appname, so until one is requested from ReliefWeb this source may return an authorisation error; the updater logs it and skips this source rather than failing.

name: UN Careers
notes: Central UN job portal, including UN Secretariat internships (UNDP/UNEP/UNICEF also post many roles here and on their own portals).

name: UNEP Careers
notes: UN Environment Programme — see its Careers / internships section; many vacancies are also listed on UN Careers and Impactpool.

name: UNDP Jobs
notes: UN Development Programme vacancies and internships, including water, climate and environment portfolios.

name: UNICEF Careers
notes: Includes WASH (water, sanitation and hygiene) roles, including UNICEF Nigeria.

name: World Bank Careers
notes: Includes the World Bank Internship Program and Young Professionals Program; the Bank is a major water-sector employer/funder.

name: WaterAid
notes: International WASH NGO with country programmes including Nigeria — see its Jobs section.

name: IRC WASH
notes: IRC International Water and Sanitation Centre (Netherlands) — WASH systems-strengthening organisation, active in Africa.

name: IHE Delft Institute for Water Education
notes: World's largest international water-education institute; MSc/PhD programmes, scholarships and vacancies.

name: Stockholm International Water Institute (SIWI)
notes: Organiser of World Water Week; posts vacancies, internships and water prizes/fellowships.

name: International Water Association (IWA)
notes: Global water-professionals network; jobs, events and young-water-professional opportunities.

name: DAAD Scholarship Database
notes: German Academic Exchange Service — use the DAAD scholarship database linked from the site; includes In-Country/In-Region awards for Sub-Saharan Africa and water/environment programmes at 2iE and elsewhere.

name: Erasmus Mundus Catalogue
notes: Official EU catalogue of Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (fully funded), including GroundwatCh (groundwater & global change).

name: Commonwealth Scholarships
notes: UK Commonwealth Scholarship Commission — Master's/PhD awards open to Nigerians and other Commonwealth citizens.

name: Chevening Scholarships
notes: UK government fully funded one-year Master's scholarships, open to Nigerians.

name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
notes: Scholars Program for African students at partner universities — see the Scholars section on the Foundation site.

name: ScholarshipPortal
notes: Large searchable database of scholarships worldwide, filterable by field and nationality.

name: Scholars4Dev
notes: Curated scholarships for students from developing countries, with deadline round-ups.

name: Opportunities For Africans
notes: Major opportunity aggregator for Africans; the RSS feed is fetched automatically by the updater.

name: Opportunity Desk
notes: Global youth opportunities aggregator (scholarships, internships, fellowships, exchange programmes).

name: Hot Nigerian Jobs
notes: One of the largest Nigerian job boards; strong for engineering, NGO and graduate-trainee listings.

name: Jobberman Nigeria
notes: Nigeria's best-known jobs platform; engineering and environmental roles plus graduate programmes.

name: MyJobMag Nigeria
notes: Nigerian job board with useful field/industry filters, including engineering and NGO jobs.

name: NGO Jobs Nigeria (NGOJobsite)
notes: NGO/humanitarian jobs in Nigeria — a key source for WASH roles with UNICEF, INGOs and local NGOs.

name: SuSanA (Sustainable Sanitation Alliance)
notes: Sanitation-sector alliance; partner organisations post vacancies on its discussion forum (forum.susana.org, 'Jobs, consultancies, internships' category). SuSanA itself also points readers to Josh's Water Jobs.

name: RWSN (Rural Water Supply Network)
notes: Global rural-water network (secretariat hosted by Skat Foundation, Switzerland); news, mentoring and sector announcements.

name: African Water and Sanitation Association (AfWASA / AfWA)
notes: Continental association of water/sanitation utilities (HQ Abidjan); runs research scholarships for young African water and sanitation professionals. Formerly the African Water Association (AfWA, afwa-hq.org).

name: Devex
notes: International-development jobs board; strong WASH and environment coverage.

name: Impactpool
notes: Careers platform for UN agencies and international organisations, including many UNEP/UNDP/UNICEF water roles.

name: Josh's Water Jobs
notes: Specialist water-sector jobs board, frequently recommended by sector bodies (including SuSanA) for water and sanitation postings.

name: IWMI Careers
notes: International Water Management Institute vacancies, including West Africa (Accra) water research roles. Added 2026-11-11 to widen coverage beyond NGO/WASH adverts into water research and hydrology.

name: IITA Careers
notes: International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (Ibadan, Nigeria) vacancies, including water, irrigation and climate roles. Added 2026-11-11.

name: African Development Bank Careers
notes: AfDB vacancies and Young Professionals Program; the Bank funds and staffs major African water infrastructure. Added 2026-11-11.

name: Nigeria Ministry of Water Resources
notes: Federal Ministry of Water Resources and Sanitation. Government water roles are rarely advertised online; check for vacancy notices and agency announcements (NIHSA, River Basin Development Authorities). Added 2026-11-11.

name: WaterAid Careers
notes: WaterAid global careers, including WaterAid Nigeria WASH roles. Added 2026-11-11.
